observations: Two retail boxes labeled 'Wireless Controller' with 'FOR Switch/PS4/PS3/PC/Cloud/Android' printed on them - these are generic third-party controllers, not official Sony DualShock controllers.
A coiled HDMI-style cable and a power cable with a UK-style plug are visible.
Bottom right of the frame shows a white, flat-topped console corner with rounded edges and a visible disc slot line, partially cropped.
No model plate, serial sticker, logo, or power button area of the console is visible.
Watermark reads 'GAME ARENA OFFICIAL' and 'POSTED ON JIJI', indicating a marketplace listing photo, not a fresh personal photo.
Console color is white; official PS4 Pro units are predominantly black/dark grey in standard retail form, white is more associated with base PS4 or Slim variants or special editions.

Photo or video of the console powered on, showing the home screen.
Photo of the full console body (not cropped) from front and back.
